svg.title: British Columbia — Department of Travel Industry
svg.desc: A hand-reconstructed vector interpretation of the supplied 644 × 468 pixel logo: a green British Columbia silhouette, two dogwood flowers and cream lettering. The central flowers were revised to match the additional user-supplied floral reference. Map geometry, floral curves and letterforms were deliberately rebuilt. No embedded bitmap, automatic tracing, external font or filter is used. Fine floral details and letterforms are reconstructed interpretations, not an authenticated original master.
